messages:
maria chen: urgent FYI — embeddings 5xx spike in eu-west1 started ~5m ago, looks like kvcache eviction bug in runtime. built hotfix image redwood/infer-runtime:2026-03-hotfix-1 (sha: a1b2c3d). requesting expedited prod canary and pin for impacted pool.

devon: ack. canary window is fine from my side. what are rollback criteria?

maria chen: rollback if 95p latency > 2s for 10m or error rate >1% above baseline. rollback image sha: z9y8x7w. also watch token cost delta.

jordan-oncall: oncall here — need eng-sre + release lead approval before push. ops-sre, can you confirm capacity?

ops-sre: capacity checked, eu pool has spare nodes. i'll run health checks during canary. :thumbsup:

releasebot: deploy request received — redwood/infer-runtime:2026-03-hotfix-1 -> env=prod pool=eu1 strategy=canary(5%). requested by maria chen.

deploy-bot: starting canary deploy: 5% traffic -> 20% over 15m. command: ```kubectl rollout status deployment/infer-runtime -n prod```

ashley: +1 from release lead for expedited deploy. please include a short release note bullet.

devon: quick smoke test ready: ```curl -sS https://eu1.api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq .``` expecting 200 and payload latency <200ms.

deploy-bot: canary at 5% complete, monitoring 15m. no error increase after first 5m. :eyes: 

maria chen: promoting to staged rollout 50% now. pinning traffic router to image a1b2c3d.

jordan-oncall: saw a small tail latency blip at +9m — 95p ~1.9s, under threshold but keeping an eye.

ops-sre: verified no new 5xx spikes, load looks normal. rolling forward.

devon: documented rollback command for quick action: `kubectl set image deployment/infer-runtime infer-runtime=redwood/infer-runtime:z9y8x7w -n prod && kubectl rollout restart deployment/infer-runtime -n prod`

maria chen: release notes draft: - Hotfix: resolved embeddings 5xx in EU pool (kvcache eviction fix) - Deployment: redwood/infer-runtime:2026-03-hotfix-1 (sha a1b2c3d) - Rollout: staged canary -> 100% with 15m watch. i'll post to #release-notes once at 100%.

incident-bot: created incident INC-2026-1234 for embeddings 5xx in eu-west1.

deploy-bot: rollout completed to 100% at t+25m. all pods ready, no crashloop.

jordan-oncall: holding monitoring — verified production metrics stable for 30m, no regression. marking as closed. :white_check_mark: 

ashley: thanks team — please push changelog entry and close INC-2026-1234 in the incident tracker. good job moving fast and safe.
